body.normal: The Importer Exporter Code certificate shows the code a business needs to import or export. It carries the company's name, address and the 10-character IEC, which is the same as its PAN.
body.simple: It shows the code the company needs to import or export.
body.detail: The Directorate General of Foreign Trade issues the IEC. Banks and customs ask for it when the company sends or receives foreign payments for goods or services. The details must be confirmed online every year, even when nothing has changed.
body.why: Without an IEC the bank and customs cannot process most import and export transactions.

facts.v: Company name, address and the IEC
Customs clearance and foreign trade payments
Keep it on file; your project lead handles the yearly confirmation

citations.label: Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act 1992, section 7
